title: Timber Ridge
description:
Timber Ridge is a small neighborhood on the corner of Stagecoach and the newly opened up Rosewood Dr. in East Killeen, near Harker Heights.  It features newer single story homes at good prices, and is an option to consider for anyone looking for single story homes with space and at competitive prices.  It is walking distance from Purser Family Park in Harker Heights and the new YMCA.
